sentences.text: Taubatornis is a bird belonging to the family Teratornithidae.
This species represents the oldest known member of its family.
Fossil remains were discovered in the Tremembé Formation within the Taubaté Basin in São Paulo state, Brazil.
The type species of the genus is Taubatornis campbelli.
The genus was named by Olson and Alvarenga in 2002.
The time range for Taubatornis is estimated between 27.3 and 23.04 million years ago.
The existence of Taubatornis supports the hypothesis that the Teratornithidae family originated in South America.
